Description: Welcome to Athlete Home, the leading Egyptian brand specializing in top-notch sports gear and apparel. Our mission is to offer a wide range of high-quality products to cater to all your sports needs. With our commitment to excellence and dedication to manufacturing products with Egyptian hands and spirit, we guarantee that you'll find everything you need under our roof.

Brand Introduction:

  • Athlete Home: Committed to providing high-quality sports gear, apparel, and fitness accessories.
  • Established Reputation: Known for our excellence in the Egyptian market with over 30 years of experience.

Product Description:

  • Sports Gear: Barbells, dumbbells, crossfit tools, steps, mats, and wraps designed for durability and precision.
  • Sports Machines: High-quality machines for home and commercial gyms, including crossfit rigs, benches, half racks, and squat racks.
  • Sports Wear: Comfortable and functional sportswear for men and women, including suits, bags, shirts, pants, towels, and socks.

Unique Selling Point (USP):

  • High Quality: Products designed to withstand intense workouts.
  • Egyptian Manufacturing: Support for local economy with locally-made products.
  • Customer Satisfaction: Special return & exchange policy, guarantee of up to 2 years on select products.

Payment Terms:

  • Flexible Options: Accepting PayPal, Bank Transfer, and Debit Card for payments.

Other Information:

  • Powerful Online Presence: Strong social media exposure with 225,000 followers.
  • Community Engagement: Active participation in sports events and awareness campaigns.
  • Support for Palestine: Monthly revenue donation and exclusive discounts to support Gaza.

List Your Featured Products (0 products submitted):

  1. Sports Gear: Dumbbells, barbells, crossfit tools.
  2. Sports Machines: Benches, squat racks, crossfit rigs.
  3. Sports Wear: Apparel for men and women, including suits, bags, shirts, and more.
